meta.title: ShareAux — Self-hosted Real-time Music Sharing
meta.description: Create rooms, search for music together, and stream to all participants in real-time. Self-hosted, open-source.

hero.title: Listen Together,
hero.subtitle:
A self-hosted platform where everyone in the room hears the same song at the same time.
Create a room, queue up tracks, and vibe together.

items.title: Real-time Streaming
items.desc: WebSocket audio streamed to all participants simultaneously. Cast to Chromecast, HomePod, or Apple TV.

items.title: Permission System
items.desc: Granular per-room controls. Host manages who can queue, skip, or chat.

items.title: Synced Lyrics
items.desc: Line-by-line karaoke display with AI translation and pronunciation guides.

items.title: Live Chat
items.desc: Slash commands, @mentions, and floating emoji reactions.

items.title: Queue Management
items.desc: Drag & drop reorder, vote skip, and Auto DJ when the queue runs dry.

items.title: Guest Access
items.desc: Invite code — join without an account.

items.title: Self-hosted
items.desc: Docker one-liner. Your data, your server.

steps.title: Create a Room
steps.desc: One click to create. Share the invite code with friends.

steps.title: Search & Queue
steps.desc: Search for music, add to the shared queue. Everyone can contribute.

steps.title: Listen Together
steps.desc: Audio streams in real-time to all participants. Same song, same moment.

quickStart.title: Quick Start
quickStart.desc: Get running in under a minute with Docker:
quickStart.code:
git clone https://github.com/Protomothis/ShareAux.git
cd ShareAux
cp .env.example .env
docker compose up -d
